label: Country identifier
definition: Harmonized source country name; GreatBritain is the United Kingdom label used in the monthly panel.

label: Calendar month
definition: Monthly observation date. All 28 source countries have a complete 144-row date grid, with missing variable values retained.

label: Calendar month as date
definition: First day of the month; a time-series index, not an observation-day timestamp.

label: Total exports, nominal
definition: Seasonally adjusted export values inherited from the Albers–Uebele panel. Monetary units differ across countries; this is not a volume or common-currency series.

label: Total imports, nominal
definition: Seasonally adjusted import values inherited from the Albers–Uebele panel. Monetary units differ across countries; this is not a volume or common-currency series.

label: Wholesale prices
definition: Seasonally adjusted wholesale-price index; index bases differ across source countries.

label: Economic activity, EAC
definition: Seasonally adjusted source activity index excluding disaggregated trade data and central-bank series. Supplies the baseline partner-demand control.

label: Economic activity, IR
definition: Seasonally adjusted source activity index excluding nominal data and trade data. Supplies an alternative partner-demand control.

label: Exchange rate against the US dollar
units_or_format: Local currency units per US dollar
definition: Harmonized cleaned quotation; a rise denotes depreciation against the dollar. Consult currency_basis and fx_clean_note for source-unit treatment.
source: Board of Governors (1943), Table 173, via FRASER; author harmonization

label: Currency quotation basis
definition: Original package note on currency units or the quotation basis; retained verbatim.

label: Exchange-rate cleaning note
definition: Original package cleaning annotation; retained verbatim.

label: Log export value
definition: Natural log of positive TOTEX; missing if export value is missing or non-positive.

label: Log import value
definition: Natural log of positive TOTIM; missing if import value is missing or non-positive.

label: Log export/import ratio
definition: ln_x minus ln_m. Primary outcome; it measures the relative value of exports and imports, not the trade balance in currency units.

label: Normalized trade balance
definition: (TOTEX minus TOTIM) divided by (TOTEX plus TOTIM), using source values.

label: Log nominal USD rate
definition: Natural log of lcu_per_usd_clean. Higher values denote depreciation against the dollar.

label: Log bilateral real USD rate
definition: ln_ner_usd plus log US wholesale prices minus log domestic wholesale prices. Higher values denote real depreciation.

label: Monthly real depreciation against USD
definition: First difference of ln_rer_usd on the original monthly grid. Positive values denote real depreciation; 0.10 is approximately a 10% depreciation.

label: Chained European real effective rate
units_or_format: Cumulative natural-log changes; arbitrary level origin
definition: Cumulative sum of available monthly real effective depreciation changes using lagged annual bilateral total-trade weights. This is not an index normalized to 100; rebase explicitly before plotting levels.
source: Author construction; League of Nations bilateral weights

label: Chained European nominal effective rate
units_or_format: Cumulative natural-log changes; arbitrary level origin
definition: Cumulative sum of available monthly nominal effective depreciation changes. A rise denotes depreciation; rebase explicitly before plotting levels.
source: Author construction; League of Nations bilateral weights

label: Monthly European real effective depreciation
definition: Weighted mean of domestic-minus-partner nominal FX changes plus partner-minus-domestic wholesale-price changes. Uses year t-1 total-trade shares for months in year t and renormalizes observed partner weights. Positive denotes depreciation.
source: Author construction; Albers–Uebele prices, Board (1943) FX, League of Nations trade weights

label: Monthly European nominal effective depreciation
definition: Weighted mean of domestic-minus-partner nominal FX changes. Uses the same observed FX-and-price partner set as the real rate in the submitted implementation.
source: Author construction; Board (1943) FX, League of Nations trade weights

label: Chained partner activity, EAC
units_or_format: Cumulative weighted natural-log changes; arbitrary origin
definition: Cumulative weighted monthly growth of partners’ EAC activity indices, using lagged annual trade weights renormalized over available activity observations.
source: Author construction; Albers–Uebele activity, League of Nations weights

label: Partner activity growth, EAC
definition: Monthly weighted partner EAC activity growth used contemporaneously and at two lags in baseline local projections.
source: Author construction; Albers–Uebele activity, League of Nations weights

label: Chained partner activity, IR
units_or_format: Cumulative weighted natural-log changes; arbitrary origin
definition: Cumulative weighted monthly growth of partners’ IR activity indices; alternative partner-demand control.
source: Author construction; Albers–Uebele activity, League of Nations weights

label: Partner activity growth, IR
definition: Monthly weighted partner IR activity growth, an alternative partner-demand control.
source: Author construction; Albers–Uebele activity, League of Nations weights

label: Observed FX-and-price basket share
units_or_format: Share of European partner basket, 0 to 1
definition: Sum of prior-year normalized European partner weights with the FX and price observations needed for adjacent-month changes. The sample screen requires at least 0.60. This is not coverage of worldwide trade. Tiny rounding overshoots above 1 are preserved.

label: Observed EAC activity basket share
units_or_format: Share of European partner basket, 0 to 1
definition: Sum of prior-year partner weights with EAC activity observations needed for adjacent-month changes. This coverage share does not define the baseline screen by itself.

label: Observed IR activity basket share
units_or_format: Share of European partner basket, 0 to 1
definition: Sum of prior-year partner weights with IR activity observations needed for adjacent-month changes.

label: Observed FX-and-price partners
definition: Number of partners used for the monthly effective-rate change.

label: Partners with positive available annual weights
definition: Number of positive-weight partners in the relevant annual basket before monthly FX-and-price exclusions.

label: Annual trade-weight year
definition: Year t-1 assigned to monthly observations in year t. A year value alone does not imply available weights; the annual source starts in 1927.

label: Currency-unit screen
definition: Original package screen excludes Austria before May 1925 and Hungary before February 1926; the lagged annual baseline begins in 1928.

label: Baseline eligibility screen
definition: True for the 18 baseline home countries with safe currency units, nonmissing log export/import ratio and REER change, and observed European FX-and-price basket share at least 0.60. 1,829 records pass. It is not an estimation-sample flag at every horizon.

label: Depression-period eligibility
definition: Baseline screen restricted to January 1929 onward.

label: Core-country eligibility
definition: Baseline screen restricted to Austria, Belgium, Czechoslovakia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Sweden and Switzerland.

label: Market-currency eligibility
definition: Baseline screen restricted to Belgium, Czechoslovakia, Denmark, Finland, France, Great Britain, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden and Switzerland.

label: Extended European eligibility
definition: Uses the same value, FX, currency-unit and 0.60 coverage requirements for the 18 baseline countries plus Yugoslavia.

label: IR-control eligibility
definition: Baseline eligibility plus a nonmissing chained partner IR activity control. Additional regression-specific missingness is handled during estimation.
